$comment: Glass-only elements (Liquid Glass plan 4.4, 8.5; plans/REVISION-DEFAULT.md R13). The 8.5 action-inventory check (stage 4) fails on any glass-only action not listed here. A 'duplicate action' entry names the classic element it duplicates on the same route, behind the same gate; an 'appearance control (no data action)' entry has no classic twin: it changes only the viewer's own appearance and reads or writes no other data. appearance-render.guard.test.ts checks that every data-glass-only element in the source is listed.

kinds.duplicate action: Goes where an existing classic element on the same route goes, behind the same permission gate; classicTwin names that element.
kinds.appearance control (no data action): The header appearance menu (Design and Theme). No classic twin on the route; no permission gate; touches only the viewer's own appearance (device record, Design cookie, own user_appearance row).

entries.$comment: ExternalAppearanceCorner. ExternalShell draws it in its page frame when the page passes no top bar; app/r/layout.tsx draws it for /r/[token], /r/track and /r/confirm, whose columns use frame="column" inside that layout. /invite/[token] and /onboarding pass a top bar that already holds the menu.
